newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL-U.S. Robotics gains remains.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL-U.S. Robotics gains remains.

text.p: Shares in U.S. Robotics Corp remained firmer preceding Tuesday's market open, the stock buoyed by the company's quarterly earnings report accompanied by a positive outlook.
Ahead of the opening bell, U.S. Robotics traded at 61-3/4, up 2-1/4 from Monday's Nasdaq close and 3/4 better than the level reached in last night's after-hours session.
The company said it earned $0.71 per share in the fiscal fourth quarter, in line with Wall Street's expectations, and better than the $0.37 per share netted in the year-ago period.
